scripts.db:init: node -e "const{mkdirSync}=require('fs');const D=require('better-sqlite3');mkdirSync('data',{recursive:true});new D('data/main.db').close();new D('data/web.db').close();" && pnpm exec drizzle-kit push --config=drizzle.main.config.ts --force && pnpm exec drizzle-kit push --config=drizzle.web.config.ts --force
scripts.db:clear: node -e "const{rmSync}=require('fs');for(const f of ['data/main.db','data/main.db-wal','data/main.db-shm','data/web.db','data/web.db-wal','data/web.db-shm'])rmSync(f,{force:true});" && pnpm run db:init
scripts.db:seed: pnpm exec tsx scripts/seed-main.ts && pnpm exec tsx scripts/seed-web.ts
scripts.db:reset: pnpm run db:clear && pnpm run db:seed
scripts.db:migrate: pnpm exec drizzle-kit generate --config=drizzle.main.config.ts && pnpm exec drizzle-kit generate --config=drizzle.web.config.ts
scripts.check:full: pnpm run check && pnpm test && pnpm run check:views && pnpm run check:hot
